name: ASIX AX88179 USB 3 gigabit Ethernet adapters
summary: A common chip in USB 3 gigabit Ethernet adapters and some docks.

linux.notes: Driven by ax88179_178a, which is built into Linux.

darwin.notes: macOS has historically needed ASIX's driver for this chip. Newer revisions of the chip (AX88179A/B) can also work in a standard mode macOS supports. If no network connection appears on your Mac, check ASIX's website for a driver for your macOS version, and do not lower your Mac's security to install one.

win32.notes: Windows normally installs the driver by itself, through Windows Update if needed.
